messages:
Maria Chen: kicking off regional tiling enable for catalog v3. plan: EU -> NA -> APAC, small canaries, pin high-RPS customers. change window: 02:00-06:00 UTC for EU.
Deploy-bot: STARTED canary enable catalog:v3 model:rw-m2-13b-quant region:eu-west-1 fraction:5% note: pinlist active
Leo Patel: copied. what's the fallback order? we should prefer the 7b for latency-sensitive routes.
Maria Chen: fallback order we decided: 1) rw-m2-13b-quant (primary) 2) rw-m2-13b-quant-gpu-slim (reduced-context) 3) rw-m2-7b (fast) 4) legacy-deterministic (last resort)
Samira Ortiz: add guardrail: if p95 latency > 950ms OR error rate increases by 2 percentage points absolute vs baseline -> abort and rollback.
Ashok Rao: add route pin TTL for enterprise customers: pin_TTL = 4h during rollout, auto-unpin after window.
Kai (prod): need tracing hooks on fallback decision points. tag all traces with rollout_id=rt-2026-03-20-01
Maria Chen: tracing enabled. preflight evals passed but watch hallucination/regression metrics on generation tests closely.
Leo Patel: on rollback, do staged rollback: 50% -> 0 in 10m steps; notify #incidents if >5% traffic rolled back.
Deploy-bot: CANARY UPDATE: succeeded for fraction=5% in eu-west-1. metrics: p95=410ms, error_rate=0.12%, cost_delta=+6%
Samira Ortiz: looks good. plan to start NA staging at 5% in 30m unless objections.
Maria Chen: no objections, scheduling NA at 1743222000 (ETA ~30m).
Leo Patel: ping SRE on-call to hold escalation line.
Ashok Rao: pinned accounts list uploaded: enterprise-pinlist-v3.csv (see files).
Maria Chen: rollout notes snippet:
```
rollout_id: rt-2026-03-20-01
sequence: [eu-west-1, us-east-1, us-west-2, ap-southeast-1]
fractions: [5, 10, 25, 50]
fallback_priority: [rw-m2-13b-quant, rw-m2-13b-quant-gpu-slim, rw-m2-7b, legacy-deterministic]
abort_conditions: {p95_latency_ms: 950, error_rate_delta_pct: 2}
pin_ttl_hours: 4
```
Samira Ortiz: I'll run the automated rollback playbook on abnormal signals.
Deploy-bot: NA STAGE PREP: scheduling canary at 1743222000, creating canary group cg-9872.
Kai (prod): can we drop a small canary prompt set for QA? uploading to s3://redwood-rollouts/rt-2026-03-20-01/canary-prompts.json
Maria Chen: monitoring dashboard: https://console.redwood/rollouts/rt-2026-03-20-01
Leo Patel: :thumbsup: keep live updates in this thread.
Deploy-bot: ROLLBACK: initiated in eu-west-1 due to error_rate spike -> deploying fallback rw-m2-7b to affected nodes. reason: error_rate=2.6% > threshold.
Maria Chen: acknowledged. opening postmortem doc.
Samira Ortiz: capturing traces and request ids now.
Leo Patel: postmortem note: consider soft-fallback earlier in future to avoid full rollback.
Maria Chen: action items: 1) lower initial canary fraction and extend dwell; 2) add synthetic prompts for safety evals; 3) tighten preflight eval thresholds.
Ashok Rao: setting follow-up meeting for tomorrow 09:30 UTC.
Deploy-bot: ROLLBACK COMPLETE: traffic back to pinned variants, rollout halted. metrics back to baseline.
Kai (prod): thanks team.
